detections.evidence_quote: after six days, Walter died of dehydration
detections.summary: Walter died of dehydration after being denied food and water during a prayer ritual.

detections.evidence_quote: strapped to a chair, denied food and water, and prayed over
detections.summary: Walter was strapped down and prayed over in what is presented as a faith-healing/exorcism ritual.

detections.evidence_quote: died during church when members of his congregation attempted to all heal him
detections.summary: An eight-year-old autistic boy died during a church healing attempt.

detections.evidence_quote: attempted to all heal him at the same time
detections.summary: The church's exorcism and laying-on-of-hands practice is described as a way to heal an autistic child.
A woman promises the boy's parents that her church can fix and heal his autism.

detections.evidence_quote: their idea is that you physically make it impossible for the demon to exist inside this body
detections.summary: The church's demon-expulsion theology is explained as the basis for the healing attempt.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The church will heal the boy's autism.
verification_candidates.rationale: A faith-healing cure claim that led parents to bring an autistic child to the church instead of medical care.
